note: Published, deterministic fees of reselling LLM gateways, keyed by provider. A fee here is applied ONLY when the session's ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL host matches one of `hosts` (exact or subdomain) or is mapped to the provider with `cost-tracker connection --map-host`. Never put a private/corporate hostname in this shipped file; map it locally instead.
